name: new-tabs-at-end
description: Chrome extension that moves only genuinely new tabs to the end of the window
author: Bruno Vicenzo

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/background.ts src/options.ts --bundle --format=esm --outdir=dist --banner:js='/*! New Tabs at End | Copyright (C) 2026 Bruno Vicenzo | GPL-3.0-or-later | https://github.com/bvicenzo/new-tabs-at-end */' && cp -r static/. LICENSE dist/
scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && zip -qr "../new-tabs-at-end-$npm_package_version.zip" .
